roleNotes.RunId: TaskSnapshot.runId and ArtifactRef.producingRunId identify execution runs; TextRunSegment.runId uses TextRunId.
roleNotes.InstanceId: EphemeralSelection.instanceId identifies an application process; EffectSpec.instanceId uses EffectInstanceId.
roleNotes.ProjectId: ChatProjectRecord.projectId and ConversationView.projectId identify assistant projects; ScopeMetadata.projectId uses ScopeProjectId; Slate project references use SlateProjectId.
roleNotes.TimelineItemId: TimelineClip.clipId and the left/right/marker clip references use the same typed timeline-item identity.
roleNotes.InlineId: InlineAtom.inlineId identifies an inline atom; NotesTextPosition.inlineId resolves the declared text-run or atom role and requires an explicit checked conversion from TextRunId or InlineId.
roleNotes.TagId: TagRecord and selected typed tag references retain their owning notebook/product context; the UUID wrapper grants no cross-owner membership.
roleNotes.discriminatedReferences: AggregateRef.id, LinkSpec.targetId, IdList.items and selector item lists resolve their ID domain from the declared kind/owner/variant; no universal untyped-ID conversion is introduced.
roleNotes.EffectInstanceId: EffectSpec.instanceId identifies the same node referenced by ProcessingGraph.outputNodeId and ProcessingEdge.sourceNodeId/targetNodeId; these are not a separate identity domain.
